summary: All in-scope criteria (C-3..C-7) are covered by SHALL requirements with checkable scenarios and tasks. D-1 (case-insensitive tags) is recorded as a default in plan.json and H-1 as a hold; nothing is silently decided. Minor gaps: the export scenario does not check the body, and 'in store order' goes slightly beyond the source.

evidence.quote: the output contains two `## ` headings in store order (C-6)

findings.issue: Export scenario does not verify the body below each heading. C-6 requires a '## title' section per note with the body below it. The requirement says 'followed by its body', but the only scenario checks just the count of '## ' headings. A critic cannot verify the body placement from the scenarios.

evidence.quote: returns one `## title` section per note with the body below it

findings.issue: 'in store order' is not stated in the sources. The handoff does not specify the ordering of exported sections. The phrase is a small addition and may conflict with the newest-first listing.

Page task and impact list a different code path than the plan. The proposal lists public/index.html as affected code, while plan.json slice S-3 owns public/** and src/server.mjs. The page scenario also does not say how N is obtained (for example, whether '1 notes' is acceptable). Clarity only.

C-4 has no task. C-4 is covered by the Copy scenario in the modified requirement and already holds in the current spec. No task is needed, but plan.json assigns it to S-1, so a regression test task could be added.
